captions.detailed: This 3D model is a cylindrical bushing designed as a toilet seat wobble fixer. It features a main cylindrical body with a thin, wider circular flange or brim at the bottom to prevent it from slipping through a hole. A circular hole runs completely through the height of the cylinder, offset from the center to accommodate alignment variations.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric toilet seat wobble fixer bushing in OpenSCAD. The design must feature a main cylindrical shim body, a thin shoulder/brim at the base, and an offset inner bolt hole that can be adjusted using a percentage parameter to handle alignment issues.
captions.factory: The script uses a difference() operation to subtract the inner bolt hole from a union of two outer cylinders. The outer union consists of a cylinder for the main shim (using hole_width and hole_depth) and a wider, thinner cylinder for the brim shoulder (using brim_height and brim_width). The subtracted cylinder represents the bolt hole, which is translated along the X-axis using an offset calculation based on the difference between the hole and bolt widths multiplied by a custom percentage factor.
